pandaos.source: Derived per server by report.load_prices(--server KEY): monthly = usd_per_month + setup_usd/12 + backup_usd_per_month; host $/h = monthly/730; per-VM $/h = host $/h / vms_overcommit_1_0 (conservative / untrusted count; 100% utilization, no operator time). density_model: trusted = vms_overcommit_1_5 on vcpu_threads, untrusted = vms_untrusted on cores.

ai_proxy.source: https://docs.boat.dev/pricing.md (Overage: 'AI credentials proxy | $1 for each day it is on, plus $1 per 1,000 requests') and https://docs.boat.dev/ai-credentials.md (Pricing: 'Each UTC day the proxy is on | $1 | The wallet of the account with the switch on'; 'Proxied requests | $1 per 1,000 | The wallet each sandbox bills'); both fetched 2026-11-17
ai_proxy.note: Charged on top of VM time and also while sandboxes are stopped. The day fee is per account switch (one per user, one per organization), not per VM. Request counting rules (errors, 403-blocked placeholders) are not defined on either page. boat.dev has no automatic AI spend cap. A sandbox that holds real keys (proxy off) pays nothing and gets no usage tracking. PandaOS's proxy has no fee.

assumptions.usd_per_eur_source: approx. spot, Oct 2026 (https://30rates.com/eur-usd-forecast-tomorrow-this-week); unverified for today
assumptions.admission: bench/boatbench/admission.py, constants read from components/boat/boatd/config.go defaultConfig(): floor((MemTotal - hostReserveMiB) x memOvercommit / (8192 + vmOverheadMiB)) default VMs (manager.go quotaLocked), capped by floor(threads x cpuOvercommit / 4). MemTotal is ESTIMATED as RAM sold x 63/64 (struct page) - 256 MiB firmware (unverified); vms_as_sold_* use RAM as sold, an upper bound. vms_untrusted: memOvercommit 1 and SMT off (threads = cores).
assumptions.extra_ipv4: none; boat.dev-style access uses IPv6 + gateway URLs. Primary IPv4 is in the Hetzner list price (EUR 1.70/mo per extra IPv4, EUR 4.90 setup); OVH US $2.00/mo per extra IP

retention.nominal_source: 51 GiB disk + 8 GiB memory snapshot (+ logs) per default VM, charged running or stopped under storageOvercommit 1 (components/boat/boatd/snapshot.go hostStorageCheck); untrustedTenants forces storageOvercommit 1
thin_gib_per_vm: measured: a stopped default VM after the Node loop setup, btrfs exclusive bytes incl. memory snapshot, 3.35 GiB; PandaOS AX42 2026-11-12, results/ax42-pandaos-2026-11-12/thin.json
retention.thin_measured_note: A fresh stopped default VM held 0.47 GiB exclusive; the 2.76 GiB guest image is shared by reflinks and counted once per host, not per VM. Thin provisioning is a MODEL: boatd ships no such setting for untrusted mode.

storage_reserve.note: boatd defaultConfig() enforces minFreePct=10 (and minFreeGiB=5) as a free-space floor via checkFloor (boatd snapshot.go; hostStorageCheck is the separate nominal-commitment check) before create/fork/snapshot, and ~5% of partition capacity goes to OS/base images and btrfs metadata reserve (~85% usable tenant storage: usable_store_gib = floor(store_gib * 0.85)). Disk-bound slot density in cost_tables.py uses usable_store_gib, never 100% raw drive capacity.

ha_and_backup.offhost_backup_source: One shared Hetzner Storage Box BX21 (5 TB off-host snapshot archive, EUR 13.20/mo x 1.12 = $14.784/mo, i.e. $14.78/mo; net +$11.20/mo delta over Hetzner's single-host 1 TB BX11 EUR 3.20/mo = $3.584/mo) replacing s['backup_usd_per_month'] so single-host backup is never multiplied by cluster_factor or double-counted. Divide this one archive by serving_hosts for per-serving-host allocations (4 in 4+1, 1 in 1+1).

topologies.label: Single host (1.00x, basic backup)
topologies.note: Single dedicated server + 1 TB backup; host reboot or hardware replacement incurs downtime

topologies.label: 4+1 N+1 cluster + 5 TB off-host backup (1.25x)
topologies.note: 4 serving hosts + 1 warm spare: total = 5 x hardware/setup + one shared $14.784/mo 5 TB BX21 archive; divide total by 4 serving hosts. Archive replaces single-host backup.

topologies.label: 1+1 HA pair + 5 TB off-host backup (2.00x)
topologies.note: 1 active host + 1 spare host (2.00x hardware/setup) + one shared $14.78/mo 5 TB BX21 off-host archive replacing single-host 1 TB backup
